The '''Z-95-AF4-H multi-role starfighter''', also known as the '''Advanced Z-95 Headhunter''' and best known as the '''Heavy '95''', was a series of modified [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]] employed by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]

==Description==
The Heavy '95s were equipped with cross-body strakes that provided better heat dissipation via redistributing the heat dissipation of the strakes through a wider area; this also allowed for more weight to be carried, giving them the nickname Heavy '95.<ref name="SZ95">{{SonyCite|url=en_US/players/content.vm?id=66872&resource=features|text=Ships: Z-95}}</ref>

==History==
The Heavy-95 was developed by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] early during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], before the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]] was available.<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|30|Heavy-95}}</ref> In large part due to the success of the Heavy '95s production, the Alliance also developed the [[advanced X-wing fighter]].<ref name="SXw">{{SonyCite|url=en_US/players/content.vm?id=66869&resource=features|text=Ships: X-Wing}}</ref>
